text: [78] dasahi bhikkhave asaddhammehi samannāgatā niganthā katamehi dasahi assaddhā bhikkhave niganthā dussīlā bhikkhave niganthā ahirikā bhikkhave niganthā anottappino bhikkhave niganthā asappurisabhattino bhikkhave niganthā attukkaṃsakaparavambhakā bhikkhave niganthā sandiṭṭhiparāmāsiadhānagāhiduppaṭinissaggino 1 bhikkhave niganthā kuhakā bhikkhave niganthā pāpicchā bhikkhave niganthā micchādiṭṭhikā 2 bhikkhave niganthā imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā niganthāti .
